t: When you think you could never learn it
a: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
p: Wa laqad yassarna-l-qur'āna li-dh-dhikr, fa-hal min muddakir.
m: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
